regression.scope: All tests/core, tests/core-ideals, tests/postgresql, tests/sqlserver, tests/tablespec, tests/avro and tests/parquet test files except field-conformance.test.ts, run separately after evidence refresh.

limits: Classification requires core 0.3.0 Field kind, retained schema/dependency bundle and explicit underlying-field-value/avro-null scope.
The claim applies only when the containing record is present. Ancestor availability, writer omission, reader defaults and logical constraints remain separate.
avsc 5.7.9 checks a temporary structural view; excluded native metadata remains retained. This is not full native schema/default/logical conformance.
Unknown numeric metadata remains exact; unresolved structural/name cases need explicit residuals or refusal.
Projection supports a single Field and 15 existing explicit carriers, with no generated reader default. Other obligations require residuals or strict refusal.
Unspecified retains no-authored-requirement intent; native-only classification cannot reconstruct authorship. Null-only cannot satisfy required.
Apache Avro Python 1.12.0 and fastavro 1.12.2 differ on input omission, boolean None coercion and reader union defaults; no implementation-wide claim is made.
Float narrowing and local-timestamp codec differences prevent general value-domain or logical-type equivalence claims.
Receipts verify reproducibility and unchanged artifacts, not authenticity. Core labels never replace native payloads.
Four priority bindings now have qualified evidence; Parquet and the experimental Nullability delivery gate remain unfinished.
